acceptancePolicy.passedMeaning: Only the explicitly bounded assertion on its recorded source. Never whole-row, all-direction or cross-level acceptance.
acceptancePolicy.notTestedMeaning: This exact criterion has no reconciled sufficient evidence; historical candidate evidence may exist and must be reviewed before rerunning.
acceptancePolicy.sourceRule: Evidence file hash is integrity metadata, not a source fingerprint. Missing source pins remain null. Matching selected pins does not prove the entire dependency closure unchanged.
acceptancePolicy.failureRule: Historical RED followed by a recorded repair/retest is not automatically a current failed criterion.
acceptancePolicy.completionRule: Every required criterion must have sufficient evidence at its required level. External pending is never PASS.

owner_isolation.assertion: Only canonical current-owner data; missing provenance suppressed; different owner and closed routes cannot leak context.

durable_integrity.assertion: Original domain authority; no duplicate writes; failure/retry/restart reconcile stored effects. Read-only paths cause no learning effects.

never_connected.assertion: Core manual path works without AI/MCP/login.

connected.assertion: Optional assistance matches the active route and state; it cannot fabricate answers, completion, scores or learner proficiency.

disconnected_or_failed.assertion: Drafts and manual completion survive disconnect/provider failure.

lifecycle.assertion: Late attachment, same-owner reconnect, background return and route disposal use current context.

direction_capability.assertion: Identify actual supported English-to-Thai/Thai-to-English capabilities; show unsupported boundaries explicitly.

answer_feedback.assertion: Exercise supported correct/wrong/empty answers, hints and repair; scratchpad/self-rating must not inherit graded-answer requirements.

exit_reentry_duplicate_restart.assertion: Exit/re-enter, repeated taps and restart preserve exactly the supported durable effects.
